outline:
指導學生進行研究專題，以培育其實務的能力，學生必須選定一實務專題，由本系教師指導，在畢業前完成成品製作，且須有書面報告。
l The objective of this course is to teach students how to do research and write technical papers. And the students have possessed the ability to do the R/D work before graduation. Each student must select the topics of special project under professor's instructions. Personal or group work should be completed the project's hardware or software and issue the paper to get the grade and credits.
schedule:
Week 1-2: Project topics
Week 3-8: Project review and discussion
Week 9-17: Project development and design
Week 18: Oral project report
materials:
1. Mohan, Undeland and Robbins, Power Electronics. John Wiley & Sons, 1995
2. B. K. Bose, Modern Power Electronics and AC drives. Prentice-Hall, 1986
3. Selected journals and conference papers.
consultation:
1. Please contact me via email (chensg@ntut.edu.tw)
2. 316 Lab. TA
sdgs:
SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）
SDG2：消除飢餓（Zero Hunger）
SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）
SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）

outline: 指導學生進行研究專題，以培育其實務的能力，學生必須選定一實務專題，由本系教師指導，在畢業前完成成品製作，且須有書面報告。
schedule:
1. 閱讀電力電子或IC設計相關書籍/資料
2. 熟習實驗環境與儀器設備
3. 定期進度報告
4. 所需軟體介紹與練習
5. 實體電路設計與製作
6. 撰寫專題報告書
scorePolicy: 依定期進度簡報、專題計畫書、實作成果、期末報告、及參與表現等項目評定成績
materials:
1. papers
2. R. W. Erickson, D. Maksimovic, Fundamentals of Power Electronics, 2nd ed., Kluwer Academic.
3. A. S. Sedra, K. C. Smith, Microelectronic Circuits, 5th ed., Oxford Univ. Press, 2004.
4. B. Razavi, Design of Analog CMOS Integrated Circuits, McGRAW-Hill, 2001.
remarks: 1. 本專題為SDG7「可負擔能源」之相關研究課程。
sdgs: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
